question: Which national park, located in a north-eastern state, is famous for being the only park in India to have four big cat species namely Leopard, tiger, clouded leopard and snow leopard?
solution:
The correct answer is **Namdapha National Park**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Namdapha National Park** lies at the** international border** between **India and Myanma**r within the **Changlang district **in the state of **Arunachal Pradesh.**
 
• It is the **only park in the world** to have **four feline species of big cat** namely **Leopard (Panthera Pardus), Tiger (Panthera Tigris), Cloud Leopard (Neofelis Nebulosa), and Snow Leopard (Panthera Unica).**
 
• **Hoolock Gibbons**, the only **'ape' **species found in India **is in this national park**.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• **Dachigam National Park** is located in **Jammu and Kashmir.**​
 
• **Periyar National Park** is situated in **Kerala.**
 
• **Nanda Devi National Park** is situated at **Uttarkhand.**
